meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 的 Bash 工具调用会自动经过 rtk 代理压缩，在运行 git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令时节省 60-90% 的 token；同时容器内会安装 rtk 二进制并配置 PreToolUse hook，无需额外指令。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要执行任何 Bash 命令时（如 git status、cargo build 等）自动触发，所有 Bash 调用都会被 rtk 接管压缩。

say.note: 该命令会被 rtk 自动压缩
测试命令同样经过 rtk 代理

say.text: 查看 rtk 节省了多少 token
say.note: 会运行 rtk gain 显示统计

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude's Bash tool calls are automatically filtered through the rtk proxy, saving 60-90% of tokens on dev commands like git, cargo, pytest. The rtk binary is installed in the container and a PreToolUse hook is configured, requiring no extra instructions.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever Claude executes any Bash command (e.g., git status, cargo build). All Bash calls are intercepted and compressed by rtk.

say_en.note: This Bash call will be compressed by rtk.
Test commands are also proxied through rtk.
Runs rtk gain to show statistics.
